Signed Binary Notice • Why Windows SmartScreen Still Prompts Temporarily

100% Cryptographically Signed: Every official RaggieSoft Studio download—including Universal Web & Offline Setup.exe launchers, inner x64 & ARM64 .msi databases, Installer Studio v0.5.0, and Accessibility Studio v1.0.0—is Dual-Layer Authenticode-signed via Microsoft Azure Artifact Signing (Verified publisher: Michael Ragsdale, RFC 3161 timestamped, and verified with signtool verify /pa).

Why SmartScreen may still say “Windows protected your PC” right now: Our Microsoft Public Trust signing certificate is brand-new (issued November 25, 2026). Under Microsoft’s current SmartScreen rules, newly issued certificates start at zero download reputation until initial install volume and Microsoft Security Intelligence (WDSI) review complete (already submitted). To install safely while reputation clears: click More info, confirm Windows shows Publisher: Michael Ragsdale (never “Unknown publisher”), and click Run anyway. Full details in the FAQ →

3. Unified Studio Update Feed (studio-apps-manifest.json)

Generated directly by instbuild.exe --emit-update-manifest, our static JSON feed powers both standalone RsUpdate.exe clients and RaggieSoft Launcher shelves with zero backend servers: 

RsUpdate.exe --manifest=https://assets.raggiesoft.com/desktop-apps/windows/studio-apps-manifest.json --app-id=installer-studio --check
RsUpdate.exe --manifest=https://assets.raggiesoft.com/desktop-apps/windows/studio-apps-manifest.json --app-id=installer-studio --apply /s
